lines.zh: 风推着我走，我推着风走。
lines.en: The wind pushes me, and I push it back.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我脚下滚成一圈。
lines.en: Grains of sand roll in a ring beneath me.
While the storm lasts, I do not rest.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，沙面又平了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the sand smooths itself again.

lines.zh: 我飘得不快，你逃得更慢。
lines.en: I drift slowly, and you flee slower still.

lines.zh: 红沙区到了，我换个颜色。
lines.en: Red sand ahead; I change my shade.

lines.zh: 风里全是沙，看不清就听。
lines.en: The air is full of sand; listen when you cannot see.

lines.zh: 脚下的沙记得我上回来过。
lines.en: The sand beneath me recalls my last visit.

lines.zh: 绕着你转，先磨掉你的耐心。
lines.en: I circle you first, wearing down your patience.

lines.zh: 身子散开又聚拢，像一阵漩涡。
lines.en: My body scatters and gathers like a small whirlwind.

lines.zh: 沙暴的边沿最薄，我贴那边走。
lines.en: The storm's edge is thinnest; I hug that side.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下细响，像谁在叹气。
lines.en: Each step hisses softly, like a sigh.

lines.zh: 雷暴一来，沙就卷成我的形状。
lines.en: In a thunderstorm, sand takes my shape.

lines.zh: 沙在我身体里转，我停不下来。
lines.en: Sand spins inside me; I cannot stop.
The wind has turned; so must my path.
Smelled it. Up ahead.

lines.zh: 沙地上，我的影子是散的。
lines.en: On the sand my shadow comes apart.
Who put rocks on my path?
My legs are stiff again.

lines.zh: 雷暴生出来的沙子，就是我。
lines.en: I am the sand born of a thunderstorm.
Light ahead. Bad.
One step at a time.

lines.zh: 脚印刚留下，就被沙填平。
lines.en: My footprints fill with sand as I make them.
Something sticky underfoot.

lines.zh: 沙在指缝里流，永远流不完。
lines.en: Sand runs through my gaps and never runs out.
When the wind dies, I thin a little too.

lines.zh: 眼睛浮在沙面上，半睁着。
lines.en: One eye floats on the sand, half open.

lines.zh: 我在数沙暴还要刮多久。
lines.en: I am counting how long this storm will blow.

lines.zh: 有人把东西埋进沙里，我看见了。
lines.en: Someone buried something here; I saw it.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙的气味，让我的沙发暗。
lines.en: Soul sand darkens the grains that make me.

lines.zh: 呼吸对我没用，可我还是学。
lines.en: Breathing does nothing for me, yet I mimic it.

lines.zh: 风一转向，我就知道要变天。
lines.en: When the wind shifts, I know the weather turns.

lines.zh: 旧沙堆里翻出一截枯枝。
lines.en: An old dune yields a dry twig to me.

lines.zh: 那些箭插过来，会自己弹开。
lines.en: Arrows that strike me simply glance away.

lines.zh: 我等着下一阵风把我撑起来。
lines.en: I wait for the next gust to lift me.

lines.zh: 沙丘的影子长了，白天快过完。
lines.en: The dune shadows lengthen; the day is ending.

lines.zh: 这片沙我认识，人换了好几拨。
lines.en: I know this sand; the people keep changing.
I settle a little to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘背风面歇着，散了一半。
lines.en: I rest leeward of a dune, half scattered.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过我，我没理它。
lines.en: A beetle crawls through me. I ignore it.
Stood too long. Forgot why.
Counting stars. Reached three.
Something moved back there.
Grains hang on my arms and will not fall.
Wind rolls in my throat. Never mind.
Wind passes through me and leaves nothing.
Just stand here, then.
Inside the sandstorm, my body spins.
The moon is so round.

lines.zh: 秃鹫在上头绕，等什么呢。
lines.en: A vulture circles above. Waiting for what?
You carry no sand; how strange.

lines.zh: 上次也是个人，站在那儿不动。
lines.en: Last time it was a person, standing very still.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，沙子认得。
lines.en: I know those boots; the sand knows them.
You should not travel during a sandstorm.

lines.zh: 眼睛会滚动，你看见了吗。
lines.en: My eye rolls in place; did you notice?

lines.zh: 你的影子压在沙上，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on my sand, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 那些掉在地上的东西，是我的。
lines.en: Whatever fell on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 你握紧那根棍子，也挡不住风。
lines.en: Grip that stick all you want; wind ignores it.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道刮得七零八落。
lines.en: The wind shreds your scent into pieces.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，你的脚印就没了。
lines.en: Stand a bit longer and your prints vanish.

lines.zh: 沙漠白天空着，晚上才有人。
lines.en: The desert is empty by day, busy at night.

lines.zh: 我在等一个理由，别给我。
lines.en: I am waiting for a reason; do not give me one.

lines.zh: 沙暴里的东西，都归沙暴。
lines.en: What is in the storm belongs to the storm.

lines.zh: 你身后那串脚印，我已经抹了。
lines.en: Those prints behind you are already erased.
Even through sand I hear you pant.
Wind spins inside my body.
Just you? Alone?

lines.zh: 沙漠风暴起来，我才现身。
lines.en: Only when the sandstorm rises do I appear.
On storm days I grow out of the sand.
Squinting like that — looking for me?

lines.zh: 汗水味，隔着沙都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell your sweat through the sand.
Are you lost?

lines.zh: 你的斗篷，挡不住我的沙。
lines.en: That cloak won't stop my sand.
Guster? Doesn't look like one.
Scatter a handful of me; I gather again.

lines.zh: 你的剑过去，只带出一阵风。
lines.en: Your blade passes through and brings out wind.
Pain? Loose sand never feels pain.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记得你的味道了。
lines.en: Now I remember the taste of you.

lines.zh: 散开的时候，我看了你一眼。
lines.en: As I scatter, I take one look at you.
Arrows do nothing to me, as I said.

lines.zh: 你把沙踢起来，反而帮了我。
lines.en: Kicking up sand only helps me.

lines.zh: 风再起时，我又是一场完整的沙暴。
lines.en: When wind returns, I am a whole storm again.
Stop swinging; you only raise dust.
I stepped back, or rather the sand did.
Sand wraps me and won't scatter.
Scattered sand gathers again. Save your strength.
One gust and this damage is patched.

lines.zh: 你把我半边肩膀打散了。
lines.en: You scattered half my shoulder.
My bone cracked.
You'll pay for that.
If the wind stops, half of me goes.
My sand shell cracked and the wind leaks out.
I'll remember, for when your throat dries.

lines.zh: 再扬一阵沙，我就回来了。
lines.en: One more gust and I'm whole again.
Food? I do not eat.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我就想要。
lines.en: Hold that up high and I want it.
The tang of redstone, that interests me.
Who holds a sandstorm eye?

lines.zh: 金属在风暴里会叫，拿过来。
lines.en: Metal sings in a storm; bring it near.
Do not coax me with food; that never works.

lines.zh: 那股气，像是同类的味道。
lines.en: That draught smells of my own kind.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我会卷起一把沙。
lines.en: Reach out and I will lift a fist of sand.

lines.zh: 风眼转动时，东西都往我这儿来。
lines.en: When my eye turns, things drift toward me.

lines.zh: 抛起来的东西，我会追着跑。
lines.en: Toss something up and I will chase it.
That armor. I want it.
Blood soaking into the sand smells fine.
The iron at your belt catches the light.
Even dry flatbread goes down.
The taste of iron works too.
you smells better.

lines.zh: 风把我的沙吹成一张嘴。
lines.en: The wind shapes my sand into a mouth.
Toss the sand over — I'll take it.

lines.zh: 沙子做的我，抓什么都漏。
lines.en: Made of sand, everything slips through me.
Give me the half you left bitten.

lines.zh: 你穿过的是一阵沙，不是一个身子。
lines.en: You walked through sand, not a body.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，沙会钻进你领口。
lines.en: Not so close; sand gets into your collar.

lines.zh: 我撞你？是风把你推过来的。
lines.en: Did I bump you? The wind pushed you here.
You have picked up grains of me.

lines.zh: 散开再聚拢，我一点没疼。
lines.en: I scatter and regroup; it does not hurt.
Do not brush at it; brushing spreads the sand.

lines.zh: 你打了个喷嚏，我听见了。
lines.en: You sneezed, and I heard it clearly.
Make way; I travel with the wind.

lines.zh: 沙落进你的眼睛，不关我事。
lines.en: Sand in your eyes is not my concern.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你的脚印就浅了。
lines.en: Touch me and your footprints thin out.
My sand shell broke and gathered again.
Watch where you're going!
Do not shove; even in a sandstorm we queue.
The sand spun you half a block off.
Bones are fine. I'm tired.
Where are you rushing to?
The wind shifted and you still hit me.
Where are your eyes?

lines.zh: 沙尘卷起来了，我就在里面。
lines.en: The dust rises, and I'm inside it.

lines.zh: 撞散我，你就得吃一嘴沙。
lines.en: Scatter me and you'll eat a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 两股风碰在一起，就成了漩涡。
lines.en: Two gusts meet and become one whirl.
Sand recognizes its own kind.

lines.zh: 风慢下来，我们才说得上话。
lines.en: Only when the wind slows can we speak.

lines.zh: 你的颜色是白，我的是黄。
lines.en: Yours is pale sand; mine is gold.

lines.zh: 沙暴里没人看得见我们。
lines.en: No one can see us inside the storm.

lines.zh: 我们合在一起，能掀翻整片沙丘。
lines.en: Joined, we could overturn a whole dune.
Do not scatter yet; wait for me a while.

lines.zh: 风停之后，我们各自落下。
lines.en: When the wind ends, we settle apart again.

lines.zh: 下一场沙暴，还在这片沙丘。
lines.en: Next sandstorm, meet me on this dune.

lines.zh: 细沙贴着细沙，声音很轻。
lines.en: Fine grains press fine grains, barely a whisper.
Let's raise a brood together.
Your hiss sounds lovely.

lines.zh: 沙暴停下时，我们成一对。
lines.en: When the sandstorm stops, we pair up.

lines.zh: 日头底下，我们谁也留不住。
lines.en: Under the sun, neither of us can hold shape.
The burrow I dug in the storm is warmest.
Three storms came before you did.

lines.zh: 沙丘背风处，够我们藏身。
lines.en: The lee of the dune will hide us both.

lines.zh: 风里那么多沙，我只认你。
lines.en: So many grains in the wind, and I know only you.

lines.zh: 雷暴一起，沙子里就有了我。
lines.en: When the storm comes, I form out of the sand.
We fit together. Really.
This half-formed lump of sand is mine.

lines.zh: 我把东西卷进去，就找不着了。
lines.en: I roll things under and they are lost.

lines.zh: 谁掉下的刃？我收进沙里。
lines.en: Whose blade fell? I take it into the sand.
My eye rises to keep watch for me.
Once in the sand, a thing is buried.
I pick things up, not to keep them.
This dry branch falls apart after two turns.

lines.zh: 掉落物是风暴的战利品。
lines.en: Dropped loot is the storm's spoils.
Stop looking for what lies in the sand.
I fling it far, just for some quiet.
Found it near claws.
I curled around this water skin first.
This iron is heavy enough.
Stuff it in my pocket.
Whatever the sand buries is mine.
What does this thing do?
Who dropped it? Doesn't matter.
A fine blade.
In the storm's sand, I keep the wind.

lines.zh: 雷暴里的沙，都往我身上贴。
lines.en: Storm sand clings to me.

lines.zh: 风把我转向你，那就你了。
lines.en: The wind turns me toward you, so you will do.

lines.zh: 你站在沙暴里，就是目标。
lines.en: Standing in the storm makes you a target.

lines.zh: 那些被你拿走的东西，还回来。
lines.en: Give back the things you carried off.

lines.zh: 上回有人也这么站着，后来没了。
lines.en: Someone stood like that before, and then was gone.
The sand begins gathering at your feet.
I need not run; wind is faster than you.
You look up at the sky; this is the moment.
A stream of sand is already aimed at you.
When you are thrown up, do not shout.
You have caved in my dune.

lines.zh: 这片地方，人少得很，正好。
lines.en: Few people come here; that suits me.
I count to three, and then you should run.
The desert is vast, but you won't get far.
When the wind dies, I scatter.
The wind is right. Now I move.
Half a day waiting, and here comes one.
Scream all you like; the wind won't stop.
Storm-born, I arrive wrapped in sand.
The storm's here — I follow the wind.
From this side. Cut them off.
Kin, over here.
The sand is already at your ankles.
In the thunderstorm, the sand obeys me.
Storm-raised sand is my stage.
I know every trace of your water.
Run faster. Let me chase a while.
Locked on. It's you.

lines.zh: 隔着风沙，你的心跳很响。
lines.en: Through the blowing sand your heartbeat is loud.
The sand chases you faster than I do.
You run east, and the wind comes from the east.

lines.zh: 脚下的沙在陷，你感觉到了吗。
lines.en: The ground sinks under you; do you feel it?
Run; the storm itself makes a fine wall.
I seal the path ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼，沙已经到脚边。
lines.en: One glance back, and the sand is at your heels.

lines.zh: 沙粒打在背上，像小石子。
lines.en: Grains strike your back like little stones.

lines.zh: 你喘得越重，风越容易找到你。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the easier wind finds you.
The red sand's edge will not let you pass.

lines.zh: 你踩出的坑，我拿沙填平。
lines.en: Every hole you dig, I fill with sand.
Do not lie down; lying down gets you buried.
My eye stays fixed on your feet.

lines.zh: 风眼一开，你就被卷进来。
lines.en: One open wind eye and you are pulled in.

lines.zh: 雷暴里的沙，把我的脚步送过来。
lines.en: The storm's sand carries my steps to you.

lines.zh: 雷雨一来，沙子就替我让路。
lines.en: When the storm comes, the sand clears my path.
When the wind dies, I scatter

lines.zh: 你喘得真厉害，雷暴还没停。
lines.en: You are panting hard, and the storm has not stopped.

lines.zh: 沙从门缝底下钻进来了。
lines.en: Sand creeps in under the door.
Grains don't tire, and neither do I.
The wind brings me your sweat.

lines.zh: 雷雨把沙吹成我的骨头。
lines.en: The thunderstorm blows sand into my bones.
In a thunderstorm, the sand obeys me.
I can slide down dunes; you can't.

lines.zh: 风里的沙，盖住你的脚印。
lines.en: The sand in my wind covers your footprints.
You dropped your waterskin. Don't turn back for it.

lines.zh: 雷暴里我转起来，你等着。
lines.en: I spin up in the storm; wait for it.
The faster you run, the more sand you raise.

lines.zh: 我的沙粒钻进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: My grains work into the seams of your armour.
The wind on that rock is mine.
The sand you stepped on is still warm.
Sand is piling up behind your door.
This stretch of sand has no edge.
The storm doesn't rest, and neither do I.
Up you go, and then down.
One blast of sand knocks you backwards.
I do not touch you; the sand does.
The landing is the part that truly hurts.
Whatever you held is gone now.
Sand works into your armor's seams.
Wind drives sand, and sand drives you.

lines.zh: 摔在石头上，我只能说抱歉。
lines.en: If you land on stone, I can only apologize.
Once is not enough; here comes another gust.
My eye spins, and your footing fails.
This blow lands, and it's all sand.
Grains are down your collar.
The wind pushes you off balance.
Open up. Have a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 沙粒钻进你的护甲缝了。
lines.en: Sand grains are getting into your armor seams.
When the storm comes, the desert is mine.

lines.zh: 铁甲挡得住刀，挡不住沙。
lines.en: Iron stops blades, not sand.

lines.zh: 我一旋身，沙就糊你一脸。
lines.en: One spin and sand fills your face.
Sand wraps your feet. You can't move.

lines.zh: 沙做的拳头，打在身上照样沉。
lines.en: A fist of sand still lands heavy.
One turn of the wind and you're down.
Sand balls into a fist and comes down.
Sand spirals into a column and bears down.
Wind and sand strike your face.
Grit scrapes off my body.
This one lands on your chest.
Sand hits like needles.
One gust, and you cannot stand.
In the sandstorm, wind shapes me.
In a storm, my hands won't obey.
The sandstorm rises, and only then do I form.

lines.zh: 沙子从四面八方贴过来。
lines.en: Sand presses in from every direction.
First the eye, then the body.
This dune was mine last year as well.

lines.zh: 风给了我形状，也给了我脾气。
lines.en: The wind gives me shape, and a temper too.
The caravan over there had best go around.

lines.zh: 我落下的地方，留一撮沙。
lines.en: Where I settle, I leave a pinch of sand.

lines.zh: 黄沙、红沙、灵魂沙，我都认得。
lines.en: Yellow, red, soul sand; I know them all.

lines.zh: 谁在风暴里丢了东西，来找我。
lines.en: Whoever lost something in the storm may ask me.
The sky has turned orange; perfect.

lines.zh: 先转一圈，把这片地量一遍。
lines.en: First a slow turn to measure this ground.
My eye surfaces and scans the horizon.
The sand is damp and hard to gather.
I have come, and now the storm looks proper.
This time I'll stay longer.

lines.zh: 我由沙子组成，风一吹就散。
lines.en: I'm made of sand. Wind scatters me.
I'm back again.
Where are my kin?
So dark. Perfect.
I only take shape once the sun drops.
Who's over there?
The storm turned the dune inside out.
Can't steady my legs yet.
In the desert storm, there I am.
The wind just spun me into shape.
The sandstorm lifted me up.
Fire-baked sand hardens into a lump.
In the thunderstorm, I carry fire.

lines.zh: 落下去，沙粒会自己停住。
lines.en: Falling only means the grains settle themselves.
No more high places.

lines.zh: 水把沙冲散了，这很麻烦。
lines.en: Water washes my sand apart; how annoying.
I can't float up.
Blast me apart; I scatter even faster.
I take shape in the storm's sand.

lines.zh: 箭头穿过去，只留一个洞。
lines.en: The arrowhead passes through, leaving one hole.
An arrow pierced my wind shell and went in.

lines.zh: 咒语把我搅乱了，沙不听使唤。
lines.en: The spell stirs me; my sand will not obey.

lines.zh: 那道光把我的沙烧硬了。
lines.en: That light baked my sand hard.

lines.zh: 饿是人的事，沙不管这个。
lines.en: Hunger is a human thing; sand ignores it.
Too hungry to move.

lines.zh: 雷把沙烧成玻璃，我少了一块。
lines.en: Lightning turns sand to glass; a piece of me is gone.
The sky is angry.

lines.zh: 没有风的地方，我散得很快。
lines.en: Where there is no wind, I come apart fast.

lines.zh: 风在虚空里也使不上劲。
lines.en: Even wind has nothing to push in the void.
